main.title: Kirby Star Allies
main.subtitle: Kirby Turns Enemies into a Team
main.summary: Kirby Star Allies turns enemies into companions and lets a group combine powers while travelling through its stages.

cards.heading: Make a friend out of an enemy
cards.text: Kirby Star Allies arrived on Nintendo Switch in 2018 with a generous recruitment tool. Throwing a Friend Heart can turn an enemy into an ally. A creature that would otherwise interrupt the journey becomes a member of the party, bringing its own ability into the next stretch of the stage.

cards.heading: Abilities that work together
cards.text: Some powers interact. An ally can add an element to another character's weapon, creating a useful combination rather than simply another body in a fight. The familiar Kirby act of borrowing an enemy's ability expands into arranging a small group whose different powers can support each other.

cards.heading: A group on one screen
cards.text: Up to three other people can join Kirby, with computer-controlled allies available when fewer players are present. The adventure therefore works with different groups around the same television. Its cooperative structure makes the Friend Heart more than a story symbol: recruiting, sharing powers and moving together are things players repeatedly do.

cards.heading: Dream Friends from earlier Kirby adventures
cards.text: The game also introduces the "Dream Friend" system, which allows the player to call upon characters from past Kirby games as special allies with expanded movesets. Bandana Waddle Dee, King Dedede, and Meta Knight can all be unlocked as Dream Friends through progression in Story Mode. Additional Dream Friends have been added via software updates.
